first_missing_criterion: Ordnance Survey's official public no-login NGD release announcement confirms that OS NGD Buildings contains real building-footprint geometry and building-use attribution (including commercial, retail and residential examples). However this public announcement is descriptive rather than a record-level no-login data window: it exposes no individual building feature geometry/identifier rows, no project canonical_parcel_id inventory, and no exact canonical_parcel_id↔OS Building binding. Therefore no record can simultaneously prove a real footprint, proven building type/use, exact canonical identity and required field evidence; accepted_count remains zero.
